parsing_rationale: L'analyse a consisté à transformer un modèle de données technique en un graphe de conformité. Les entités de données ont été extraites comme 'entity', les règles de validation comme 'functional_requirement' et les contraintes de structure comme 'constraint'. Les relations ont été établies entre les entités et les règles qui les régissent.

project_info.brief_explanation: Définition du modèle de données et des règles de validation pour un gestionnaire de dépenses local.

sections.title: Expense
sections.raw_content:
Represents a single financial expenditure record.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `id` | INTEGER | PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT | Unique identifier |
| `amount` | REAL | MUST be > 0 | Cost of the expense |
| `category` | TEXT | MUST be in {"Food", "Transport", "Bills", "Utilities"} | Spending category |
| `description` | TEXT | Optional | Brief detail about the expense |
| `date` | TEXT | MUST be ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) | Date the expense occurred |
| `created_at` | TEXT | Managed by DB (DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) | Internal record creation time |

sections.title: Validation Rules
sections.raw_content:
- **Amount**: Strictly positive. Any value $\le 0$ must trigger a `ValidationError`.
- **Date**: Must strictly match the `YYYY-MM-DD` regex.
- **Category**: Must be one of the four allowed strings. Case-sensitive.
- **Description**: Allowed to be empty, but must be a string.

sections.title: State Transitions
sections.raw_content: The data model is purely CRUD; there are no complex state transitions (e.g., "Pending" $\rightarrow$ "Approved").

sections.title: Relationships
sections.raw_content: - **User to Expense**: 1:N (Implicitly, as this is a single-user local tool, all expenses belong to the current user).

elements.content: Represents a single financial expenditure record containing id, amount, category, description, date, and created_at.
Amount must be strictly positive. Values <= 0 must trigger a ValidationError.
Date must strictly match the YYYY-MM-DD regex (ISO 8601).
Category must be one of: Food, Transport, Bills, Utilities (Case-sensitive).
Description must be a string, but can be empty.
The tool is a single-user local tool, implying all expenses implicitly belong to the current user.
